The army that reaches Berlin has paid for the ground twice over: a war fought closer to the historical pattern of holding rigid lines regardless of the arithmetic, at the cost this campaign keeps returning to. The drive on Rostov closed the door on Army Group A: the encirclement history reached for and missed, landed on this path at the favorable edge of what the winter logistics allowed. Operation Mars was scaled back rather than ████████ at full strength: sparing the Rzhev grinder's historical cost, a battle Soviet archives themselves stayed █████ about for fifty years. The Izyum salient was given up ██████ the Germans █████ close it. The armies, tanks and guns the real offensive lost in May 1942 went into the summer instead, and Case Blue met a ████████ front that had them. Berlin's fall was a certainty from the day the front stopped moving west; everything this campaign tracked was the cost of the miles back.One Year Later███████ arrived ahead of the historical May 1945, which █████ the occupation of eastern and central ██████ has had that much longer to harden by the time this account picks back up a year later.
